stages.name: Play the story
stages.summary: Chapters 1 to 4, then the final mission. Twelve trophies: the four chapter trophies, the final mission gold, and the six named story missions.
tips: Meditate on Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1 — that spot is gone after the chapter, and it is the only missable trophy.
Make a manual save at the start of every chapter. There is no mission replay.
Make a manual save before the final mission, so you can go back for cleanup.

stages.name: Strangers & freaks
stages.summary: The stranger mission strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, plus 8 strands in total for the silver. Seven trophies.
tips: Each stranger's missions unlock as you meet them — check the map for new stranger icons between story missions.
There are more than 8 strands, so pick the ones you enjoy.

stages.name: Collectibles & exploring
stages.summary: Meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK It photos, vehicles, the 52 areas of Leonida and the 8 garages. Eight trophies, including the missable one.
tips: Finish the 18 meditation spots early — the Chapter 1 balcony spot is the one that can be missed.
Sweep the map area by area for WAiNK It photos and the 52 areas, so nothing is revisited.

stages.name: Activities & challenges
stages.summary: The long grind: 42 Shooting Range golds, 250 stunts, 20 races, 14 drone races, robberies, heists and the money trophies. Twenty-six trophies.
tips: Gold the Shooting Range one challenge at a time — your best medal per challenge is kept.
Launder Marked Bills and spend in shops as you go; both money totals fill naturally.
Cheats disable trophies and saving — do not use them on a trophy run.

stages.name: Cleanup & 100%
stages.summary: Mop up whatever the checklist still shows, then reach 100% completion for the gold, and the platinum pops with it. Two trophies.
tips: Use the checklist's filters to find what is left — filter by kind and by 'not earned'.
100% completion is the hardest trophy: story, strangers, collectibles, activities and exploration all count.

title: Roadmap to the platinum
warnings: Only one trophy can be missed: Positive Mental Attitude, the Chapter 1 balcony meditation spot.
There is no mission replay. Keep manual saves at the start of every chapter and before the final mission.
No online trophies: all 55 are single-player.
